seo_title: Delhi HC: HUDCO's Siri Fort Flats Stay Residential Tax
title: Delhi High Court Rejects MCD's Bid to Tax HUDCO's Siri Fort Flats as Commercial Property
case_name: Municipal Corporation of Delhi v. Housing and Urban Development Corporation Ltd.
card_summary: MCD wanted to tax 18 HUDCO flats at Asian Games Village at the higher commercial rate instead of the residential rate HUDCO had paid since 2004-05. The flats house officials, some as transit accommodation. The Delhi High Court upheld the Tribunal's finding that nominal charges do not turn residential use commercial, and held MCD could not reopen the assessment without proving wilful suppression.
card_tip: A municipal body cannot reopen a years-old property tax assessment and reclassify its use factor without first showing wilful suppression of information within the limitation period for reopening.
verification_notes: The case number W.P.(C) 3320/2019, the parties and the 19 November 2026 date are confirmed from LiveLaw's report and from the court's own filing document carrying the same case number and a matching date-encoded filename. Only one independent reporter (LiveLaw) was found covering this specific ruling in searches run in this session; the court filing itself is treated as the second, near-primary source. The exact number of flats affected (18, per LiveLaw) and the flat-number range appearing in the filing excerpt (205-216 and 241-246) did not visibly reconcile in the material read, so the card states the flat count as reported without restating the specific flat numbers.
